title: 第15章 这是俺拾嘞第16章 智斗天花板知心大哥哥
content_zh:
逼仄的屋内，经过一番搏斗，显得有些凌乱。
李熙无力趴在冰冷的地上，双臂以诡异的角度扭曲着，双目怨毒地盯着叶离的背影。
他堂堂李家嫡子，竟被这视如草芥的贱民踩在脚下，折断双臂！
在他的注视下，叶离背对着他，伸手在床铺翻找着。
原本整齐叠好的被褥，一层层掀开，被抛至地上沾染了尘埃。
“你……你这贱民！你敢动我的东西？！”
李熙挣扎着想要起来，但叶离头也不回，声音冷冽如冰：
“如果你不想两条腿也被我踩断的话，就和狗一样，趴在地上乖乖等到教头他们过来。”
“李家不会放过你的！”
李熙咬牙切齿，试图用家族的威势找回一点底气：“你一个连入境都没有到达，我家碾死你和碾死一只鸡一样简单。”
“你应该考虑的是，自己能不能活着回家，现在距离下一次休沐还有一个月的时间。”叶离边翻找边说道。
得益于苍龙帮的封闭式管理，这些新入帮的弟子只有昨天一日出帮的时间。
若是错过，这些新人想要再出去，要么等一个月，要么成为尸体被抬回去。
所以在这期间，李家的触手伸不进来。
早在动手之前，叶离就考虑好利弊，这才悍然发起攻势。
“一个月！你一个月能做什么？”
李熙趴在地上哈哈狂笑起来：“你不会以为，你一个月以后，就能对抗我家吧！”
此刻李熙也已经看出叶离的算计，料定对方根本不敢杀死自己。
别说帮规不许！
就是自己一死，族内必定能知道消息，届时对方全家必定插翅难飞！

叶离没有回答，在翻找过后，从李熙的床位上取出一枚瓷瓶。
在取出的瞬间，李熙的咽喉犹如被掐住般陷入死寂。
“啵——”
将瓷瓶的盖子打开，叶离向内望去，4枚散发馨香的乳白丹丸映入眼底。
四枚淬体丹！
这是李熙昨日休沐时，从族内拿来的配额。
本来一共五枚，但昨日修炼被他用去一颗。
玄幻小说，战后得宝环节，不可不尝！
反正叶离自动拾取功能忘关了！
「凡人（468862）」
「苍龙劲（1425100）」
……
叶离望着面板上的经验值。
有了这些淬体丸的帮助，他有把握在20日内入境。
届时，他可以比李熙提前10日出帮，身份也将晋升为帮内核心弟子，境遇大为不同。
身为核心弟子，只要没有闹到撕破脸的地步，李家都不会在明面上对自己动手！
无论是背靠苍龙帮让李家忌惮，还是提前10日安排叔婶一家离开，都是足以做到的。
实在不行，叶离还另有底牌。
倒是不用担心因为这腌臜货色而牵连到家人。
将属于自己的淬体丸分成两份纳入怀中，叶离看了一眼脸色憋的涨红的李熙，犹如看一个废人。

两人一个趴在地上，一个站在原地等待，气氛陷入死寂当中。
“这里发生了什么事？”一个熟悉的沉稳声音传入室内。
由于这片算是帮内的新手区，都是由冯越管理，且远离二十人的大通铺！
content_en:
The cramped room looked a little messy after some fighting.
Li Xi lay helpless on the cold ground, his arms twisted at weird angles, and his eyes stared at Ye Li's back with resentment.
He was the legitimate son of the Li family, but he was trampled under his feet and had his arms broken by this untouchable man who looked down upon him like a piece of shit!
Under his gaze, Ye Li turned his back to him and reached out to rummage on the bed.
The bedding, which had been neatly folded, was lifted layer by layer and thrown to the ground to become stained with dust.
"You...you untouchable! How dare you touch my things?!"
Li Xi struggled to get up, but Ye Li didn't look back and his voice was as cold as ice:
"If you don't want both of your legs to be trampled off by me, just like a dog, lie down on the ground and wait until the instructors come over."
"The Li family will not let you go!"
Li Xi gritted his teeth and tried to use the family's power to regain some confidence: "You haven't even arrived at the border. It would be as easy for my family to crush you as crushing a chicken."
"What you should consider is whether you can go home alive. There is still a month before the next bath." Ye Li said while rummaging around.
Thanks to the closed management of the Canglong Gang, these new disciples only had time to leave the gang yesterday.
If they miss it, these newcomers will have to wait a month or be carried back as corpses if they want to go out again.
Therefore, during this period, the Li family's tentacles could not reach in.
Before taking action, Ye Li considered the pros and cons before brazenly launching an offensive.
"One month! What can you do in one month?"
Li Xi lay on the ground and laughed wildly: "You don't think that you can fight against my family in a month!"
At this moment, Li Xi had also seen Ye Li's plan and expected that the other party would not dare to kill him at all.
Don't say it's not allowed according to gang rules!
Even if he dies, the clan will definitely know the news, and then the whole family of the other party will be unable to fly!
Ye Li did not answer. After rummaging around, he took out a porcelain bottle from Li Xi's bed.
The moment he took it out, Li Xi's throat fell into deathly silence as if it was being strangled.
"Boom——"
Opening the lid of the porcelain bottle, Ye Li looked inside, and four fragrant milky white pills came into view.
Four body tempering pills!
This is the quota that Li Xi got from the clan when he took a rest yesterday.
There were originally five in total, but he used one during practice yesterday.
Fantasy novels, a must-try for finding treasures after the war!
Anyway, I forgot to turn off the automatic pickup function of Ye Li!
"Mortal (468862)"
"Cang Long Jin (1425100)"
…
Ye Li looked at the experience points on the panel.
With the help of these body-tempering pills, he is sure to enter the country within 20 days.
By then, he can leave the gang 10 days earlier than Li Xi, and his status will be promoted to the core disciple of the gang, and his situation will be very different.
As a core disciple, the Li family would not openly attack him as long as they didn't break up with each other!
Whether it was relying on the Canglong Gang to make the Li family fearful, or arranging for the uncle and aunt's family to leave 10 days in advance, it was enough.
If it doesn't work out, Ye Li still has another trump card.
Don't worry about your family being implicated because of this dirty stuff.
Dividing his body tempering pill into two parts and taking them into his arms, Ye Li glanced at Li Xi, whose face was red with suppressed expression, as if he were looking at a disabled person.
One of them was lying on the ground, the other was standing there waiting, and the atmosphere fell into dead silence.
"What happened here?" A familiar calm voice came into the room.
Because this is considered a novice area within the gang, it is all managed by Feng Yue, and it is far away from the Datong Shop with 20 people!
